matched: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) conducted to examine distribution, relationships, underlying patterns using descriptive statistics, visualization, correlation, and normality tests
Descriptive statistical measures (mean, median, std, min, max) calculated for all features and target variables to assess central tendency, variability, and identify potential anomalies or outliers
Pair plots constructed using Seaborn (0.13.2) in Python (3.13.1) with regression lines and confidence intervals to investigate pairwise relationships, clustering, and outliers
Individual scatter plots used to explore relationships between specific input features and target parameters (TMP and Spec. Flux) to detect linear/non-linear trends and outliers
Pearson correlation coefficient (r) computed and correlation matrix constructed to quantify linear relationships and assist in feature selection
Shapiro-Wilk test conducted for all features and target variables to assess normality (H0: normal distribution, H1: deviation from normality; test statistic 0 to 1; p-value threshold 0.05)
